title: Bought objective progress
description: Objectives you pay for when you score them (Erect a Monument: spend 8 resources; Sway the Council: spend 8 influence) now say 'can pay N / 8 <unit> now' instead of a bare 'N / 8', which read like a counter that only goes up.

shots.heading: Payable now (desktop)
shots.caption: Your own cells read Ready (8/8) as before. The rival's 8 / 8 cells are also satisfied.

shots.heading: Payable now (phone)
shots.caption: The same table at 390 px wide.

shots.heading: Partly payable (desktop)
shots.caption: Outside a scoring window: 'can pay 5 / 8 resources now · pay at scoring', with the progress bar. Hovering shows the explanation.

shots.heading: Partly payable (phone)
shots.caption: The label wraps inside the narrow cell.

shots.heading: Not payable (desktop)
shots.caption: Nothing ready to spend: 'can pay 0 / 8 ... now'. This is capacity, which is why it dips mid-round and recovers after the status phase readies planets.

shots.heading: Scoring window open (desktop)
shots.caption: Status-phase scoring decision. Your own cell loses the 'pay at scoring' suffix ('can pay 3 / 8 influence now'); Monument is scoreable and reads Ready. The rival's cells, whose window is not open, keep the suffix.

shots.heading: Scored (desktop)
shots.caption: The Scored badge keeps precedence over the progress text.

notes.title: Wording
notes.text: Hover text on the label: 'Bought objectives are paid for when you score them; this is how much you could pay right now with your ready planets and trade goods.' The label also carries it as an aria-label. Browsers do not render native tooltips into screenshots, so it is not visible here.

notes.title: Scoring window
notes.text: The client treats the window as open for a seat only while a score_objective or imperial_score_objective decision is pending for that seat. Fixtures are synthetic, not captured engine states.
